name: grid
description: A CSS Grid container. `columns` takes a count or a mobile-first per-breakpoint map, `gap` the spacing (a density-scaled Context token per step), and `align`/`justify` how each item sits within its cell. No inline styles: the per-breakpoint column counts resolve to modifier classes, so the responsive behaviour is correct in server-rendered markup on the first paint (RFC 0022 §8).

modifiers.name: columns
modifiers.description: The column count. The options below are the base tier, applied at every width. Each is also available per breakpoint as `primitiv-grid--{tier}-cols-{n}`, where tier is one of xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl — e.g. `primitiv-grid--md-cols-2`. Tiers are mobile-first floors, not ranges, and the stylesheet orders them ascending so the widest matching tier wins. A count outside 1–6, or a tier outside this scale, is a media query of your own against `--primitiv-grid-columns`.

modifiers.name: gap
modifiers.description: Space between tracks; each step (except none) is a density-scaled Context token, mirroring Stack's gap ramp step for step.

modifiers.name: align
modifiers.description: How each item sits within its cell on the block axis (`align-items`), as a preset set rather than a raw CSS passthrough.

options.name: start
options.description: Items packed at the block-start edge of their cell.

options.name: center
options.description: Items centred in their cell on the block axis.

options.name: end
options.description: Items packed at the block-end edge of their cell.

options.name: stretch
options.description: Items fill their cell on the block axis (the default).

options.name: baseline
options.description: Items aligned on their first text baseline.

modifiers.name: justify
modifiers.description: The inline-axis equivalent (`justify-items`). Grid distributes tracks itself, so there is no between/around/evenly here the way there is on Stack's flex justify-content.

options.name: start
options.description: Items packed at the inline-start edge of their cell.

options.name: center
options.description: Items centred in their cell on the inline axis.

options.name: end
options.description: Items packed at the inline-end edge of their cell.

options.name: stretch
options.description: Items fill their cell on the inline axis (the default).
